title: M0 Foundations
description: Repo, process, CI, ADRs and a walking skeleton (grey-box valley, stub season writing telemetry, a notebook reading it). Question: does one real PR pass the whole loop end to end?

title: M1 Simulation core
description: Headless season sim: herd, routes, three defences, harvest, one price; bots play 10,000 seasons; first route model recovers the true parameters. Question: does committing under uncertainty create interesting choices, and is there a dominant strategy?

title: M2 Bare 3D defence
description: One valley, one beast, fence, pit and harpoon tower, command view, five seasons, grey boxes. Question: is one night fun to watch and fiddle with?

title: M3 Economy
description: Exchange with supply-driven price, clean vs damaged kills, storage costs. Question: does selling create decisions or admin?

title: M4 Town, breach and the run
description: Wall, garrison, district damage, Lamphouse, a 12-season run with win, loss and score. Question: does the slow dread work, and are runs worth finishing?

title: M5 Wow and the wall
description: Dusk cold open, first-person harpoon on the wall. Question: does it impress in five seconds, and does the wall add agency?

title: M6 Town walk
description: Your house, shops, the exchange floor, rumours. Question: does walking change a decision?

title: M7 Depth
description: Survey office, evolving herds, second species, unlocks, generated valleys, modifiers. Question: is the tenth run as interesting as the third?
